baseline_verification: Run the deployed S0 financial rules unchanged, separately at1% and2%; label any unavailable exact input

candidates.definition: Exact passport and deployed signal blob; no parameter improvements in baseline verification
candidates.name: Donchian H1/H4

candidates.entry: Using the prior20 H1 close mean and sample std: LONG if close < mean-2std and ADX14<18; SHORT symmetrically
candidates.exit: Target is the frozen prior20 mean; 1.5ATR protective stop, maximum24 hours; reject if delayed entry is already past target
candidates.name: Возврат к средней цене

candidates.entry: First complete H1 of the confirmed main session defines high/low. Later closed H1 above/below it triggers LONG/SHORT; one trade per asset/session
candidates.exit: 1.5ATR stop,2R target or session-end quote, whichever occurs first; missing calendar/exit quote blocks inference
candidates.name: Диапазон открытия сессии

candidates.entry: Training-only mean next-hour return by asset and Moscow hour; at least60 training observations in a cell. Trade its sign only if absolute forecast >1.5 times estimated round-trip costs
candidates.exit: First available eligible quote60 minutes after entry, or1.5ATR stop/2R target; hourly coefficients frozen for each subsequent test fold
candidates.name: Временной эффект внутри дня

candidates.entry: At first eligible H1 decision of a trading date, rank prior20 completed daily log-return sums divided by their std. LONG the strongest if positive; otherwise SHORT the weakest. One selected asset, no borrowed extra leverage
candidates.exit: Rebalance at the next trading-date decision, with1.5ATR stop/2R target; do not manufacture a stationary BR/GOLD price spread
candidates.name: Ротация BR/GOLD по относительной силе

candidates.entry: For a closed H1 calculate Q=sum(sign(M1 close-open)*M1 volume)/sum(M1 volume). LONG if Q>=0.5, SHORT if Q<=-0.5, H1 volume>=prior20 median
candidates.exit: First available eligible quote60 minutes after entry, or1.5ATR stop/2R target
candidates.interpretation: Candle-derived proxy only. Not actual aggressor buy/sell flow, order book or executable spread
candidates.name: Давление объёма минутных свечей

chronological_testing.final_independent_test: New data strictly after chosen configuration/code are locked. No untouched historical holdout is claimed
chronological_testing.interim_rule: Any parameter change after inspection starts a new trial and a new independent evaluation period
chronological_testing.prospective_horizon: Predeclare90 calendar days at the final model lock; report sample size and uncertainty, extend only by a preregistered rule
chronological_testing.purge_and_embargo: At least5 calendar days at fold boundaries, extended for actual label/position horizons; indicator warmup uses past inputs only
chronological_testing.walk_forward: Expanding training; next calendar quarter evaluation starting2025. Fit/scaling/threshold selection uses training only

common_comparison.baseline_common_wrapper: Any aggregate-risk admission difference from frozen S0 is reported separately; never presented as an unchanged live baseline
common_comparison.risk_2_percent: Sensitivity only; not a primary selection criterion
common_comparison.risk_5_or_10_percent: Optional stress only; never counts as a strategy improvement
same_for_every_strategy: Source, common eligible contracts and verified overlap period
Broker and exchange fees, spread/slippage scenarios
Margin, integer contracts, joint risk cap and FX convention
common_comparison.strategy_native_exits: Different by hypothesis and predeclared, not selected from test results

decision: PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE/BLOCKED_DATA. Missing result is not zero return. No winner if evidence is insufficient.

execution_tracks.agent: Independent observed execution quote after decision; actual recorded controller times where available
execution_tracks.human: First executable quote after Telegram server acceptance plus reaction-time scenario; never fill at signal close
execution_tracks.missing_BBO: Only explicitly approximate price scenarios; exact live-equivalent return remains null
execution_tracks.unknown_historical_delivery: Do not copy a single no-signal-summary delay into all past trading-signal timestamps

metrics: Net return and net expectancy after costs
Skipped whole-contract trades and data failures
Dependence, overlap and uncertainty; no assumed independence of strategies
objective: Falsify or support an edge after real constraints; do not prove a predetermined winner

operational_safety.real_money_transition: Separate explicit user decision; never automatic

search_accounting.inference: Report all trials; dependence-aware resampling, conservative multiple-comparison adjustment where justified; do not claim a valid total-search p-value with unknown legacy trial count
search_accounting.optimization: No parameter grid until unchanged-baseline and data-quality checks complete; a later bounded grid must be committed before scoring
search_accounting.rule: Log every family, parameter configuration, fit, failed run, cost/delay scenario and inspected dataset; do not reset the count to six
